methodology.scope: Phase 2 CPU career lifecycle model using shared age development, activity cadence, regional templates, professional invitation gates and retirement pressure.
methodology.proInviteDefinition: First week the shared tour invitation rule is satisfied: a rating fast track or the rating, tour-points and match-experience bar.
methodology.contractDefinition: First CPU contract level after a pro invitation and sufficient tour points.
caveats: CPU matches use the same rating expectation and skill-gap calculation, not full engine rallies.
Background athletes age deterministically but are summarized rather than individually stored.
The model intentionally reports simulation evidence; human scorecards and physical-device measurements remain separate release gates.
